Sam: Huge congrats Edda!! :tada: Manager and elopement, chef's kiss. Wed 10 works for me.
Ibrahim: Congrats!! Iceland elopement sounds epic. I'll bring coffee.
party-bot: Reminder created: "Edda pastries" on 1726077600 (Wed 10:00) — react to RSVP by EOD Tuesday.
